faq.description: Everything you need to know before you buy — files, sizes, licence and delivery.
faq.note: Can't find what you're looking for? Message us on Instagram — we answer within a day.

items.question: What do I get after buying?
items.answer: A download link with the full-resolution files and a short readme covering sizes and licence.

items.question: Mobile and desktop?
items.answer: Both, sold as separate collections — each composed for that screen, never cropped from the other.

items.question: What resolution?
items.answer: Wallpapers at 7680 × 4320 and 1440 × 3120. Covers at 3000 × 3000 RGB.

items.question: Can I use it commercially?
items.answer: Cover artwork includes a release licence for one project. Wallpapers are personal use only.

items.question: How fast is delivery?
items.answer: Instant — the link is on the confirmation screen and in your account.

items.question: Spotify and Apple Music?
items.answer: Yes. Every cover ships at the exact spec distributors ask for.
